name: Drawing, Tanka boats off the coast, Macau
summary: This drawing of Tanka boats off the coast, dated 4 April 1839, was made by Chinnery during his long residence in Macau from 1825 until his death in 1852; during this time he visited Canton (Guangzhou) between 1825 and 1832, and spent six months in Hong Kong in 1846.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
